dct_description_sm: "Base map from U.S.G.S. Kanab (1967) 7.5' quadrangle ; Project manager, Robert F. Biek ; Cartographer, J. Buck Ehler."

CD contains geographic information System (GIS) files in ESRI file geodtabase and shapefile formats. Also included are two plates -- the geologic map and explanation sheet in PDF format. The Kanab 7.5 quadrangle includes the city of Kanab and the Vermillion Cliffs step of the Grand Staircase.
Contributors: Hayden, Janice M.; Utah Geological Survey, cartographer.
Publication statement: Salt Lake City, Utah : Utah Geological Survey, 2011.
Relief shown by contours and spot heights.
Requires Adobe Acrobat PDF Reader. Specialized GIS software is required to use the GIS files.
dct_title_s: Geologic map of the Kanab 7.5ʹ quadrangle, Kane County, Utah and Coconino and Mohave Counties, Arizona
